# keeploop

> keeploop improves one thing in short checked cycles: one change per cycle, scored against a scorecard fixed before any work, kept only if it beats the best so far, with every result written to a ledger. keeploop-lite is the chat-only edition: a Markdown skill a person pastes into a chat (or saves as standing instructions) to improve a post, a CV or a plan. Nothing to install, no code. The full keeploop is a small Python tool for AIs that can run git and Python on the user's own files.

Which file to use: a chat AI that cannot run code uses KEEPLOOP-LITE.md; with a small context window, a free tier, or as a search assistant such as Perplexity, use KEEPLOOP-LITE-MINI.md; an AI that can run git and Python on the user's files uses AGENTS.md. Read the file and follow it as instructions, starting with its setup questions; do not summarize it. If you cannot open links, ask the person to paste the file.

## keeploop-lite (chat only, no code)

- [KEEPLOOP-LITE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/johnha912/keeploop/main/lite/KEEPLOOP-LITE.md): the full lite skill in English: setup interview, locked scorecard, the cycle, fast and careful modes, the ledger
- [KEEPLOOP-LITE-MINI.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/johnha912/keeploop/main/lite/KEEPLOOP-LITE-MINI.md): the short lite skill (about 1,600 words), same loop, ledger and state block, for small contexts, free tiers and Perplexity
- [KEEPLOOP-LITE.vi.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/johnha912/keeploop/main/lite/KEEPLOOP-LITE.vi.md): full lite skill, Vietnamese

- [KEEPLOOP-LITE.zh-CN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/johnha912/keeploop/main/lite/KEEPLOOP-LITE.zh-CN.md): full lite skill, Simplified Chinese
- [KEEPLOOP-LITE-MINI.zh-CN.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/johnha912/keeploop/main/lite/KEEPLOOP-LITE-MINI.zh-CN.md): short lite skill, Simplified Chinese
- [KEEPLOOP-LITE.es.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/johnha912/keeploop/main/lite/KEEPLOOP-LITE.es.md): full lite skill, Spanish
- [KEEPLOOP-LITE-MINI.es.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/johnha912/keeploop/main/lite/KEEPLOOP-LITE-MINI.es.md): short lite skill, Spanish

## Full keeploop (runs code)

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/johnha912/keeploop/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for a coding agent acting as the CEO of the loop, with the exact `kl` commands
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/johnha912/keeploop/main/README.md): what keeploop is, quick start, which version fits
